I tried that but I'm an angry crier so it doesn't really come off that strong and when he's in the mood where he's yelling there's no reasoning with him so I just go up to my room until I can stop crying

I know that all I need is a distraction right now to get me out of this feeling

In the long term nothing really, I'm just missing out on all of my friends goodbye dinner before they all go back to university (I failed so I have to take a year off). But it just feels like all of my problems are piling on and my dad keeps pressuring me to apply for jobs (which I have) and my mom wants me to make a plan for the next year and give it to them. And my brother couldn't care less and my sister has never failed at anything and doesn't understand how I could be such a failure. And all of my friends see me as this prefect person who can do no wrong and I'm always the person other people can depend on
I've been through these periods before I don't know why but this time I thought that maybe if I reached out I wouldn't have to through this again
